DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 雨が強くなってきましたね。地図の散策コースをご覧ですが、どのくらい時間がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: The rain is getting heavier. You are looking at the walking routes on the map; how much time do you have?

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 夕方五時には駅に戻りたいです。濡れた道を長く歩かずに見学できる場所を探しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 五時までに駅へ戻りたいことと長い雨中の徒歩を避けたい希望を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to return to the station by five this evening. I am looking for somewhere to visit without a long walk on wet paths.
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want to return to the station by five and avoid a long walk in the rain. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この練習用地図には屋内展示と商店街があります。展示へ行くバスは、こちらの時刻表で確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: This practice map has an indoor exhibition and a shopping street. You can check the bus to the exhibition on this timetable.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 大きなかばんを持っているので、先に駅で預けたいです。その後でも展示を見る時間は取れそうですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 大きなかばんを駅で預けてからでも展示へ行けるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have a large bag, so I would like to store it at the station first. Would there still be time to see the exhibition afterward?
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can visit the exhibition after storing a large bag at the station. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 預ける時間を含めて比べてみましょう。展示の見学に何分くらい使いたいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us compare including the time to store it. About how many minutes would you like for the exhibition?

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 一時間は見たいです。帰りのバスを待つ時間も入れて、駅から出る時刻を考えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 一時間の見学と復路の待ち時間を含めて出発時刻を考えたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I want at least an hour. I would like to plan my departure from the station including the wait for the return bus too.
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you want to plan departure including an hour's visit and the return wait. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: では、帰りを先に決めましょう。この表の二つの便なら、どちらに余裕を持って乗れそうですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Then let us decide the return first. Which of these two services could you catch with time to spare?

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 遅い便だと駅に着くのがぎりぎりなので、早い便を目標にしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 遅い便では余裕がなく早い便を目標にする理由を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: The later one would get me to the station at the last minute, so I would like to aim for the earlier one.
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that you want the earlier service because the later one leaves no margin. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 早い便に合わせると、展示を出る目安が決まります。荷物を預けられなかった場合の案も必要ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Aiming for the earlier service gives us a target time to leave the exhibition. You also need a plan if you cannot store your bag.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 預けられなければ遠くへ行かず、駅の近くで過ごします。今日はその二つの案を持って動きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 荷物を預けられなければ駅付近にとどまる案も用意すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: If I cannot store it, I will stay near the station instead of going far. Today I will travel with those two plans ready.
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will also prepare a plan to stay near the station if you cannot store your bag. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 出発前に時刻表の表示も確かめてください。雨の中ですから、時間に余裕を持って。お気をつけてお出掛けください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Check the timetable display before setting off too. Since it is raining, allow plenty of time. Take care on your outing.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お持ち帰りをご希望ですね。お一人分ですか、それとも何人かで分けて召し上がりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like takeaway, correct? Is it for one person, or will several people share it?

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家族二人で食べます。一人は辛い物が苦手なので、同じカレーを分けるか迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二人で食べるが一人は辛い物が苦手で注文方法を迷っていると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Two family members will eat it. One dislikes spicy food, so I am unsure whether to share the same curry.
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say two people will eat, one dislikes spicy food, and you are unsure how to order. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この練習用メニューでは、甘口と辛口を別に選べます。一つずつにした方がよさそうでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: On this practice menu you can choose mild and hot separately. Would one of each be better?

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 甘口を一つと辛口を一つお願いします。辛口の方だけ、ご飯を少なめにできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 甘口と辛口を一つずつ頼み辛口だけご飯を減らせるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: One mild and one hot, please. Could only the hot one have less rice?
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Order one mild and one hot and ask for less rice only with the hot one. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご飯の量は分けて伺えます。具を追加する場合は、どちらに付けるかも教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: We can take separate rice quantities. If you add ingredients, also tell us which curry to add them to.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 野菜の追加は甘口の方だけにします。二つの容器を見分ける印を付けてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 甘口だけ野菜を追加し容器を見分ける印を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Extra vegetables only for the mild one. Could you mark the two containers so we can tell them apart?
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Add vegetables only to the mild curry and request identifying marks on the containers. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ふたに甘口と辛口を書きます。持ち帰る間に傾けないよう、袋も別にしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will write mild and hot on the lids. Should we also use separate bags so they do not tilt on the way home?

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 自転車ではなく歩いて帰るので、一つの袋に平らに入れてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 徒歩で帰ることを示し一袋に平らに入れてもらう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I am walking home rather than cycling, so please lay them flat in one bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you are walking home and ask for them to be placed flat in one bag. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 平らに入る袋を用意します。カレーとご飯は、それぞれ分けた容器でよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will prepare a bag that holds them flat. Would you like the curry and rice in separate containers?

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ご飯にかける量を自分で決めたいので、カレーとご飯を分けた容器でお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: かける量を調節したいのでご飯とカレーを別容器にする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I want to decide how much to pour on the rice myself, so please separate the curry and rice.
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask for rice and curry in separate containers so you can adjust how much you pour on. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 甘口の野菜追加と、辛口のご飯少なめで準備します。出来上がったらお呼びします。それでは、受け取りの際にまたお声掛けします。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will prepare mild with extra vegetables and hot with less rice. We will call when ready. We will speak again when you collect them.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 休憩場所の様子を見に来ました。日よけの下でお困りのことはありませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: I came to check the rest area. Is anything troubling you under the sunshade?

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 風で日よけの端が何度も浮いています。自分で向きを変えるより、先に相談した方がよいと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 風で端が浮く状況を説明し自分で動かす前に相談したと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: The wind keeps lifting the edge of the shade. I thought I should ask you before changing its direction myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Describe the edge lifting in the wind and say you consulted staff before moving it yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 知らせてくださってありがとうございます。こちらで片付けますので、まず荷物を手元にまとめてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Thank you for telling us. We will put it away, so first gather your belongings close to you.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 荷物はまとめます。子どもを連れて、どちらの場所で待てばよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 荷物をまとめると答え子どもと待つ場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I will gather them. Where should I wait with my child?
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Agree to gather your belongings and ask where to wait with your child. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この練習場面では、建物側の待機スペースへご案内します。日よけのそばには戻らず、私を待ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: In this practice situation, we will show you to the waiting space beside the building. Wait for me without returning near the shade.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 建物側へ移ります。借りた椅子も、私たちが運んだ方がよいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 建物側へ移動すると確認し借りた椅子を自分で運ぶ必要があるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will move toward the building. Should we carry the borrowed chairs too?
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm you will move toward the building and ask whether you need to carry the rented chairs. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 椅子はこちらで回収します。貸出札だけお持ちください。札はなくしていませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will collect the chairs. Please bring only the rental tag. Have you kept it?

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 札はかばんの内側にあります。荷物を置いてから返却窓口に持って行ってもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 貸出札の所在を伝え荷物を置いてから窓口へ持参できるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: The tag is inside my bag. May I bring it to the return counter after putting my things down?
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Give the rental tag's location and ask to bring it to the counter after setting down your things. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、落ち着いてからお越しください。海辺へ戻る前には、その時の案内を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, come once you have settled. Before returning to the beach, check the guidance at that time.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日は海辺へ戻らず、建物で休んでから札を返します。回収をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 海辺へ戻らず建物で休んだ後に札を返すと決め回収を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will not return to the beach today. I will rest in the building and then return the tag. Please collect the chairs.
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide not to return to the beach, to rest in the building before returning the tag, and ask for collection. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 椅子の回収はお任せください。待機スペースまでご一緒します。札の返却が済んだら、お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Leave chair collection to us. I will go with you to the waiting space. After returning the tag, take care going home.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 乗船のご相談ですね。人数と、お持ちになる荷物を先に伺えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like advice about boarding, correct? May I first ask how many passengers and what luggage you will bring?

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 一人です。写真を撮るための長い三脚がありますが、船内へ持ち込めるでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 一人で乗ることと撮影用の長い三脚を持ち込めるかを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: One person. I have a long photography tripod; may I bring it aboard?
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you are traveling alone and ask whether you can bring a long photography tripod aboard. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この練習用案内では、通路に広げる物は使えません。折り畳んだときの長さはわかりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: This practice guidance does not allow use of items spread out in the passage. Do you know its folded length?

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 畳むと六十センチくらいです。船内では広げず、袋に入れて持つつもりです。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 約六十センチで船内では広げず袋に入れて持つと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: About sixty centimeters folded. I plan not to open it aboard, but to keep it in its bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say it is about sixty centimeters and you will keep it bagged without opening it aboard. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 大きさは担当者に確認します。今ここで持込みを確約できないので、確認前に予約を確定しない方がよさそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will check the size with the person responsible. I cannot guarantee permission now, so it would be best not to finalize a booking before checking.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: それでは予約はまだ確定しません。確認の返事は、この窓口で待てばよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 持込み確認前は予約を確定せず返事を待つ場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I will not finalize the booking yet. Should I wait at this counter for the answer?
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Do not finalize the booking before checking permission, and ask where to wait for the reply. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 窓口の横でお待ちください。その間に、三脚を置いて来られる場所があるかも考えておくとよいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please wait beside the counter. Meanwhile, consider whether there is somewhere you can leave the tripod.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 宿泊先に置いて来られますが、往復の時間が必要です。集合時刻も一緒に確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 宿泊先へ置きに行けるが往復時間が要るので集合時刻を確認したいと言う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I can leave it at my accommodation, but I would need time for the round trip. I would also like to check the meeting time.
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you can leave it at your accommodation but need round-trip time, so want to check the meeting time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 集合時刻は練習用の案内票にあります。往復する場合に間に合うか、この時刻と比べてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: The meeting time is on the practice information slip. Compare it with your round trip to see whether you would make it.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 案内票を見て往復の余裕を確かめます。持込みが難しければ三脚を置いてから申し込みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 案内票で時間の余裕を確かめ難しければ三脚を置いてから申し込むと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will check the slip and see whether there is enough time for the round trip. If bringing it is difficult, I will leave the tripod first and then apply.
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will check the time margin on the slip and leave the tripod before applying if permission is difficult. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 担当者の返事が来たらお知らせします。予定を決めるまで案内票をお持ちください。それでは、確認後にまたお話ししましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will tell you when the person responsible replies. Keep the information slip until you decide your plans. Let us speak again after confirmation.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 揚げ物の盛り合わせをご覧ですね。ご注文の前に確認したいことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are looking at the mixed fried platter. Is there anything you want to check before ordering?

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: えびのアレルギーがあります。盛り合わせの中身と、同じ油で揚げる物を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: えびのアレルギーを示し盛り合わせの中身と油の共用について尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have a shrimp allergy. Please tell me what is in the platter and what is fried in the same oil.
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: State your shrimp allergy and ask about platter contents and shared oil. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 中にえびが入ることは確認できます。油を共用しているかは、調理担当に聞いてからお伝えします。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: I can confirm it contains shrimp. I will tell you whether the oil is shared after asking the cooking staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: えびだけを外しても判断できないので、油についての返事を待ちます。まだ注文は入れないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: えびを外すだけでは決められない理由を述べ油の返事まで注文を入れないよう頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Removing only the shrimp is not enough for me to decide, so I will wait for the oil information. Please do not enter an order yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain why just removing shrimp is insufficient and ask them not to order until the oil reply arrives. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 注文は保留にします。調理担当によると油は共用していますが、ほかの器具については今すぐ確認できないそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will hold the order. The cook says the oil is shared, but they cannot immediately confirm the other utensils.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 油は共用で、器具は未確認ということですね。別の料理も、材料がわからないままでは選べません。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 油は共用で器具は未確認と確認し不明な料理も選べないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: So the oil is shared and the utensils are unconfirmed. I cannot choose another dish without knowing its ingredients either.
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm shared oil and unconfirmed utensils, and say you cannot choose other dishes with unknown ingredients either. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、こちらから食べられるとお約束はできません。同行の方と相談する間、このメニューを置いておきますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Correct, we cannot promise you can eat it. Shall I leave this menu while you discuss it with your companion?

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: メニューは下げてください。同行者と相談して、今日は食事をせずに出るか決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: メニューを下げてもらい食事をせず出るか同行者と相談すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please take the menu away. I will discuss with my companion whether to leave without eating today.
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask them to take the menu and say you will discuss leaving without eating with your companion. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: わかりました。揚げ物の注文は入れていません。お決まりになったら声を掛けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. We have not entered the fried-food order. Let us know once you decide.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 相談しましたので、今日は二人とも注文せずに帰ります。確認してくださってありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二人とも注文しないと決定を知らせ確認への礼を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: We have discussed it, and neither of us will order today; we will go home. Thank you for checking.
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Announce that neither person will order and thank staff for checking. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。お役に立てる情報がそろわず申し訳ありません。どうぞお気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. I am sorry we could not provide all the information you needed. Please take care going home.

DLG-SC-EHM-SAIJO-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-EHM-SAIJO-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 尾根までの予定ですか。今朝は上のほうに雲がかかっています。
DLG-SC-EHM-SAIJO-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you planning to go as far as the ridge? Clouds are covering the higher areas this morning.

DLG-SC-EHM-SAIJO-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-EHM-SAIJO-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 初めて来ました。午後三時までに戻りたいのですが、尾根まで歩けるでしょうか。
DLG-SC-EHM-SAIJO-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 初めての登山で午後三時までに戻りたいと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-EHM-SAIJO-001-SHARED-02.translation: This is my first visit. I want to return by three this afternoon; could I walk to the ridge?
DLG-SC-EHM-SAIJO-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for advice on a first hike with a desired return by three in the afternoon. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-EHM-SAIJO-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-EHM-SAIJO-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 足の速さでも変わるので、時刻だけでは判断できません。雨具はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-EHM-SAIJO-001-SHARED-03.translation: That also depends on your walking speed, so we cannot decide by time alone. Do you have rain gear?

DLG-SC-EHM-SAIJO-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-EHM-SAIJO-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 上着はありますが、雨具は持ってきませんでした。短い道に変えたいです。
DLG-SC-EHM-SAIJO-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 雨具がないため短い道に変更したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-EHM-SAIJO-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have a jacket, but I did not bring rain gear. I would like to change to a short route.
DLG-SC-EHM-SAIJO-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you want to change to a short route because you have no rain gear. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-EHM-SAIJO-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-EHM-SAIJO-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: それなら、入口の案内板で近くの散策路を確認しましょう。どの道を考えていますか。
DLG-SC-EHM-SAIJO-001-SHARED-05.translation: Then let us check nearby walking paths on the entrance information board. Which route are you considering?

DLG-SC-EHM-SAIJO-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-EHM-SAIJO-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 地図の青い線が気になります。この線は小屋まで戻る道ですか。
DLG-SC-EHM-SAIJO-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 青い線が小屋に戻る経路か確かめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-EHM-SAIJO-001-SHARED-06.translation: I am interested in the blue line on the map. Is that a route back to the hut?
DLG-SC-EHM-SAIJO-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check whether the blue line is a route back to the hut. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-EHM-SAIJO-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-EHM-SAIJO-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この図では一周して戻りますが、今日通れるかは掲示も見てください。分岐の先はどうしますか。
DLG-SC-EHM-SAIJO-001-SHARED-07.translation: In this diagram it loops back, but also check the notices to see whether it is open today. What will you do beyond the fork?

DLG-SC-EHM-SAIJO-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-EHM-SAIJO-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 通行案内を読んで、分岐で雲が濃くなっていたら引き返します。
DLG-SC-EHM-SAIJO-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 掲示を読み、分岐で雲が濃ければ戻ると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-EHM-SAIJO-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will read the access guidance and turn back if the clouds are thicker at the fork.
DLG-SC-EHM-SAIJO-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Decide to read the notice and return if clouds are thick at the fork. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-EHM-SAIJO-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-EHM-SAIJO-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 同行する方にもその予定を伝えてください。戻った後の連絡先は決めていますか。
DLG-SC-EHM-SAIJO-001-SHARED-09.translation: Tell your companions that plan too. Have you decided whom to contact after returning?

DLG-SC-EHM-SAIJO-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-EHM-SAIJO-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 家族に短い道へ変更したことと、戻ってから連絡することを伝えます。
DLG-SC-EHM-SAIJO-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 経路変更と帰着後の連絡を家族に伝えると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-EHM-SAIJO-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will tell my family I changed to a shorter route and will contact them after I return.
DLG-SC-EHM-SAIJO-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will tell your family about the route change and contact them on return. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-EHM-SAIJO-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-EHM-SAIJO-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、出発前に掲示を見ていってください。無理をせず、お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-EHM-SAIJO-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then check the notices before setting off. Do not push yourself, and take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 今日は黄色い札の列から収穫します。まず、どの列か指してみてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Today we will harvest from the row with a yellow tag. First, please point to the row.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 入口から二番目の列でしょうか。奥にも黄色に見える札があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二番目の列と奥の札を区別できないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Is it the second row from the entrance? There is also a tag farther back that looks yellow.
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you cannot distinguish the second row from the tag farther back. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 奥は白い札で、生育を観察する列です。入口側の札を近くで見ましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: The one farther back is white, for the row where we observe growth. Let us look closely at the entrance-side tag.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: こちらが黄色ですね。観察する列の実は取らず、この列だけを担当します。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 観察用の列を残し黄色い札の列を担当すると確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: This one is yellow. I will leave the fruit in the observation row and handle only this row.
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm that you will leave the observation row alone and work on the yellow-tagged row. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ええ。使うはさみはこの箱にあります。切り方を一度見ますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. The scissors are in this box. Would you like to see how to cut once?

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。茎をどのくらい残すのか、手元を見せてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 茎を残す長さが分かるよう切る手元を見せてもらう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please. Show me your hands so I can see how much stem to leave.
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to see the cutting technique so you understand how much stem to leave. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この位置で切ります。実に傷を見つけたときは、収穫箱に混ぜないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Cut at this position. If you find damage on the fruit, do not mix it into the harvest box.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 傷のある実は別のトレーに置いて、後で見てもらえばよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 別のトレーに分けて確認を受ける方法を提案する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Should I put damaged fruit on a separate tray for you to check later?
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Suggest separating them onto a different tray for checking. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そのように分けてください。箱がいっぱいになったら、重ねずに声をかけてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please separate them that way. When the box is full, call me without stacking more on top.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 札と切る位置を確かめて始めます。箱がいっぱいになったら呼びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 札と切る位置を確認し箱が満杯になったら呼ぶと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will check the tag and cutting position before starting. I will call when the box is full.
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will check the tag and cutting position and call when the box is full. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、最初の一つを一緒に見てから始めましょう。今日の作業、よろしくお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then let us inspect the first one together before starting. Thank you for your work today.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お持ちの封筒は水道の通知ですね。どの点が気になりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: The envelope you have is a water-service notice. What concerned you?

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 引っ越した後に届きました。古い住所が書かれているので、まだ使っている扱いなのか心配です。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 転居後に旧住所の通知が届いて利用状況が心配だと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: It arrived after I moved. It has my old address, so I am worried they still treat me as using the service there.
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say an old-address notice arrived after moving and you are worried about service status. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 住所だけでは利用の状況は分かりません。いつまで旧居に住んでいましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: The address alone does not tell us the usage status. Until when did you live at your previous home?

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 先週の日曜日までです。利用を終える連絡をしたか、同居人に確認できていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 日曜日まで住み利用終了の連絡は同居人に未確認と答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Until last Sunday. I have not checked with my housemate whether they notified the end of service.
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Answer that you lived there until Sunday and have not checked the termination notice with your housemate. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: では、その点を確かめましょう。新しい住所の書類も同じ袋に入っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Then let us check that. Are your new address's documents also in the same bag?

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 入っています。間違えないように、旧居の通知と新居の書類を分けて出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 旧居の通知と新居の書類を分けて提示すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I will take out the old-home notice and new-home documents separately so I do not confuse them.
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will present the old-home notice and new-home documents separately. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。この通知の対象期間を読んでから、担当に内容を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Thank you. After reading the period covered by this notice, we will check the details with the person responsible.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ここにある期間は引っ越し前ですね。住所の変更とは別に、利用終了の確認が必要でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 通知期間を読み住所変更と利用終了を別に確認する必要があるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: The period here is before my move. Do we need to check service termination separately from the address change?
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Read the notice period and ask whether address change and service termination need separate checking. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: それも含めて担当に尋ねましょう。連絡した日が分かるものはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let us ask the person responsible about that too. Do you have anything showing the date of contact?

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 帰宅して同居人に聞き、連絡した記録があれば持ってきます。今日は確認する項目をメモしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 同居人に聞いて記録を探し今日の確認項目をメモすると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will ask my housemate when I get home and bring any record of contact. Today I would like to note the points to check.
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will ask your housemate, look for records and note today's points to check. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 確認項目を一緒に書きましょう。また相談するときは、この通知もお持ちください。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Let us write the points together. Bring this notice when you consult us again too. Take care going home.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 証明書についてのご相談ですね。提出先からの案内はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like advice about a certificate, correct? Do you have instructions from its recipient?

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 住宅の申込みで住所が分かる書類を求められましたが、証明書の名前は書いてありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 住宅申込みの書類案内に証明書名がないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: For a housing application, I was asked for a document showing my address, but it does not name a certificate.
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the housing application instructions do not name the certificate. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらで提出先の指定は判断できません。本人分だけか、ご家族の分も必要か分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: We cannot determine the recipient's requirements here. Do you know whether it is only for you or also your family?

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: その点も不明です。家族全員の情報を載せてよいのか、先に聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 家族全員の情報が必要か先に提出先へ聞きたいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I do not know that either. I would first like to ask whether I should include information for the whole family.
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you want to ask the recipient first whether information about all family members is needed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 必要な範囲を確認するとよいですね。ほかに発行日についての記載はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: It would be best to check the necessary scope. Is anything else written about the issue date?

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 申込みの日付しかありません。いつ発行されたものが必要かも問い合わせます。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 案内には申込み日しかなく必要な発行日を問い合わせると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Only the application date. I will also ask when the document needs to have been issued.
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say the guidance only has the application date and you will ask about the required issue date. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 問い合わせる間、申請書の記入は待ちましょう。窓口で聞いたことをメモしますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let us wait to fill in the application while you ask. Will you note what you heard at the counter?

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。証明書名、載せる人の範囲、発行日の条件の三つをメモします。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 証明書名と記載対象と発行日の条件を三点メモする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I will note three points: certificate name, which people's information to include, and issue-date conditions.
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Note the three points: certificate name, people included and issue-date conditions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 指定が分かったら、その案内を見ながら相談できます。今日はどうされますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Once you know the requirements, we can consult using that guidance. What will you do today?

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日は発行を頼まず、提出先へ電話します。返答を受けたら案内を持って来ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 今日は発行せず提出先へ電話して返答の案内を持参すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will not request issuance today; I will phone the recipient. After receiving a reply, I will bring the instructions.
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide not to request issuance today, to call the recipient and bring the reply's guidance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。指定を確かめてからまたご相談ください。お帰りの際はお忘れ物のないように。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. Check the requirements and consult us again. Please leave nothing behind when going home.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 列車の検索画面をお持ちですね。ご希望の出発日はいつですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have a train search screen. What departure date would you like?

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 金曜日の夜に出て、土曜日の朝に着きたいです。この候補で切符を買いたいのですが。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 金曜夜に出発して土曜朝に到着したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to leave Friday night and arrive Saturday morning. I would like to buy a ticket for this option.
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want to leave Friday night and arrive Saturday morning. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この画面の出発日は土曜日になっています。日付を選ぶとき、到着日を入れましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: The departure date on this screen is Saturday. Did you enter your arrival day when choosing the date?

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、着く日の土曜日を入れてしまいました。出発を金曜日に直して探します。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 到着日を入れた間違いに気づき金曜出発で探し直す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, I entered Saturday, the arrival day. I will change departure to Friday and search again.
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Recognize that you entered the arrival date and search again for a Friday departure. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 日付を直したら、出発駅と乗り換えも見比べてください。何時まで仕事がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: After correcting the date, compare the departure station and transfers too. Until what time do you work?

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 午後八時までです。駅までの移動もあるので、それより後の候補を探してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 仕事が八時までで駅への移動を考えた候補を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Until eight in the evening. I also need to travel to the station, so please look for options later than that.
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say work ends at eight and ask for options allowing travel to the station. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 検索条件を一緒に見ましょう。途中で翌日になる場合も、それぞれの時刻の表示を読みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let us check the search conditions together. If the date changes en route, read the display for each time too.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この乗り換えは翌日の表示ですね。待ち時間も含めた予定を紙に書いてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 翌日表示を読み待ち時間を含む予定を書いてもらう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: This transfer is marked as the next day. Could you write the itinerary on paper including the waiting time?
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Read the next-day indication and ask for a written itinerary including waits. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 購入前の確認用に書きましょう。往復の予定はもう決めていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let us write it for checking before purchase. Have you decided your return plans yet?

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 帰りの日はまだ決まっていないので、今は行きだけの購入条件を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 帰路が未定のため行きのみの購入条件を確認すると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have not decided the return date, so for now I will check the conditions for buying just the outward trip.
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say your return is undecided, so you will check purchase conditions for the outward trip only. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、行きの日付と経路から確認しましょう。ご相談ありがとうございました。旅の準備、お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-SAIJO-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then let us start with the outward date and route. Thank you for consulting us. Take care with your travel preparations.
